naming_policy: Original archive names remain in frozen source tables for traceability. Readers should use the labels below; RevB is an archive identifier, not a distinct biological model. R18 and R18E are source identifiers; reader-facing biomass labels are Metabolic capacity and Empirical capacity. Observation-expression settings remain separate.

Dynamic RevB.label: Dynamic metabolic capacity with depth-retention surface expression

Fixed capacity RevB.label: Fixed-capacity toxin source with depth-retention surface expression

Biomass source RevB.label: Biomass-proportional toxin source with depth-retention surface expression

Dynamic q80 RevB.label: Dynamic metabolic capacity with depth-retention surface expression

Model biomass and composition.label: Regression on model biomass and composition

biomass_models.R18_surface_x145: Metabolic-capacity model, fixed x1.45 surface observation scale
biomass_models.R18E_surface_x145: Empirical-capacity comparator, fixed x1.45 surface observation scale

risk_model.name: Frozen two-stage risk and conditional-tail branch
risk_model.status: Separate sensitivity/risk analysis; does not replace the formal OLS concentration evaluation
risk_model.selection: Archived nested LOYO selection records; no parameters are selected by the release evaluation command

historical_columns.*_fixed_archived_prediction_ugL: Historical fixed mapping applied to the current surface-expression input. Retained for archive identity; excluded from the seven-model main evaluation outputs.
historical_columns.refit_ols: Archive identifier: coefficients were fitted previously. The release only applies the frozen coefficients.
historical_columns.refit_q80: Archive identifier: q0.80 coefficients were fitted previously. The release only applies the frozen coefficients.

units_warning: Observed surface total MC (ELISA) is distinct from MC-LR process concentrations. Neither unmapped process values nor the observational dissolved fraction validate biochemical production or all three pool fractions independently.
